purpose: FLIXO model admission and sustainability policy
important: An approved SPDX-style license class is not sufficient by itself; model-specific terms and acceptable-use policies must also be checked.
License status does not establish ownership of base weights, adapters, datasets, or derivative works.
Training-data provenance is a separate admission gate.
production_rule: Only PASS may be production-eligible, and PASS still requires compatibility, security, evaluation, and human approval under the FLIXO control plane.
candidate_catalog_rule: Candidate catalog entries are non-admitting. They may be reviewed for future FLIXO use, but they must not be copied into the production manifest without exact version, artifact SHA-256, license text, model terms/AUP, provenance, compatibility, security, evaluation and human approval.
